posts.title: New iPod Game - Myst
posts.edited: Last Edit: May 04, 2009, 06:13:07 PM by Skipper
posts.html:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XTFyj-L4mrs

What do you think? Are point and click games a good direction for mobile game consoles like the iPod Touch and iPhone?

The game is $6/£3.50, and needs 1.5GB of free space for install (which then whittles down to 727MB when installed, due to the way iPod/iPhone handles install data).
